Replacement instructions for laptops

You will find the replacement instructions for the NUC Box further down this page.

6 min
Easy

Requirements:

  • A soft underground – You could use a towel
  • A container to put the screws in – Make sure you don’t lose the screws
  • Screwdriver
  • Spudger (or a similar plastic tool)

Step 1: Remove the screws

Put the laptop upside down on a soft underground.

This is needed to prevent scratches on the laptop’s screen lid. Then, remove all the screws with the screwdriver.

Step 2: Remove the bottom case

Take the spudger and put it between the bottom case and the hinge.

Gently apply pressure to the hinge. Do this on both sides. You can then carefully remove the bottom case entirely.

Step 3: Replace the WiFi module

You can now replace the WiFi module.

To remove the existing WiFi module, remove its screw. The module will pop out and can be taken out. Remove the antenna cables from the module with care.

To install your WiFi module, insert it with an angle of about 30°. Reattach the antenna cables, but please don’t use excessive force since the antennas and the antenna plugs are fragile.

Make sure that the module is pushed correctly in its slot. Once it’s in, push the module down at the outside and install the belonging screw.

Important:
The antenna cables and the plugs at the module are fragile. Make sure you push the antennas in place with proper force – never use excessive force.

The white WiFi antenna plug shuold be attached to MAIN, while the transparent WiFi antenna plug should be attached to AUX.

Step 4: Place the bottom case back in place

Install the bottom case by placing it back in the right position.

Gently press the part on all sides.

Make sure that the bottom case fits snugly everywhere.

Step 5: Install the screws

Use the screwdriver to install the screws back in place. In case of the V54 Series: play close attention to the two screws at the hinges: these are bigger than the other screws.

This was the final step, you are ready to use your laptop again.

Well done!

Replacement Instructions for NUC Box

5 min
Very easy

Requirements:

  • A soft surface – You can use a towel, for example
  • A small container to put the screws in – Make sure you do not lose any screws
  • Screwdriver

Step 1: Remove the screws

Place the NUC Box upside down on a soft surface.

This prevents scratches on the NUC Box.

Then remove all screws using the screwdriver.

Step 2: Remove the bottom cover

Pick up the NUC Box and carefully turn it over.

Next, grip the top cover at all corners.

Lift it off from the bottom.

Step 3: Replace the WiFi module

You can now replace the WiFi module.

To remove the existing WiFi module, remove the screw. The module will pop up and can be removed. Carefully disconnect the antenna cables from the module.

To install your new WiFi module, insert it at an angle of approximately 30°. Reattach the antenna cables, but do not use excessive force, as the antennas and antenna connectors are fragile.

Make sure the module is properly seated in its slot. Once it is in place, press the outer edge of the module down and reinstall the corresponding screw.

Important:
The antenna cables and the connectors on the module are fragile. Make sure you attach the antennas using the correct amount of force – never use excessive force.

The white WiFi antenna connector must be connected to MAIN, while the transparent WiFi antenna connector must be connected to AUX.

Step 4: Reinstall the bottom cover

Place the bottom cover of the NUC Box back in the correct position.

Make sure the arrow labeled front is actually pointing towards the front.

You can verify this by slightly lifting the NUC Box at the front.

Step 5: Reinstall the screws

Use the screwdriver to tighten the screws back into place. Note: do not overtighten the screws. Otherwise, it will become very difficult to remove them again in the future if necessary.

The new bottom cover is now installed.

Well done!

Please make sure that the thermal pads that are delivered with the laptop are placed at the indicated places. The thermal pads make sure that your SSD remains cool, even under heavy load.

It is vital to have them in place to ensure a long life time of your SSD storage drive.

Step 4: Place the bottom case back in place

Install the bottom case by placing it back in the right position.

Gently press the part on all sides.

Make sure that the bottom case fits snugly everywhere.

Step 5: Install the screws

Use the screwdriver to install the screws back in place. In case of the V54 Series: play close attention to the two screws at the hinges: these are bigger than the other screws.

This was the final step, you are ready to use your laptop again.

Well done!

Pick up the NUC Box and carefully turn it over.

Next, grip the top cover at all corners.

Lift it off the bottom part.

Unscrew the two black screws on both sides.

Remove the WiFi antennas from the WiFi module.

Carefully lift the motherboard up from both sides.

Turn the fan over, as the CMOS battery is located here.

Turn the CMOS battery clockwise and gently pull it upwards.

Tighten the screws.

Carefully reconnect the cables.

Screw the two black screws back into the motherboard.

Place the bottom of the NUC Box in the correct position.

Carefully guide the module toward the hinges.

Take a spudger and gently place it underneath the hinge.

Apply a fair amount of force and push the hinges upward until they can’t move any further.

Put the laptop upside down on a soft underground.

This is needed to prevent scratches on the laptop’s screen lid. Then, remove all the screws with the screwdriver.

Step 2: Remove the bottom case

Take the spudger and put it between the bottom case and the hinge.

Gently apply pressure to the hinge. Do this on both sides. You can then carefully remove the bottom case entirely.

Step 3: Disconnect the battery

Disconnect the battery temporarily.

This is a security measure to avoid short circuits.

It is highly recommended to do this step.

Step 4: Remove the internal memory module(s)

You can now install or replace the desired internal memory modules.

To remove an internal memory module, move both metal clip holders to the side at the same time.

The module will pop out and can be taken out.

Step 5: Remove the SSD storage drive(s)

To remove an SSD, remove its screw.

The module will pop out.

You can now take out the SSD storage drive.

Step 6: Remove the WiFi module

To remove the existing WiFi module, remove its screw.

The module will pop out and can be taken out.

Remove the antenna cables from the module with care.

Step 7: Remove the heatsink

Unplug the heatsink cables.

Remove the heatsink screws. The screws that are marked with the numbers 1 and 2 stay in place, while the other screws go out entirely.

Carefully lift the heatsink at both sides. This can be a bit stiff because of the sticky thermal paste.

Step 8: Remove the adhesive keyboard strips

Hold the adhesive strip thighly and pull it gently.

One adhesive strip is located at the place of the heatsink, while the other one can be found at the left side of the battery.

Make sure that you pull it gently to make sure that the strip doesn’t break.

Step 9: Remove the keyboard

Use the micro screw driver to press in the keyboard screw fit, while the laptop is on its side.

The keyboard will pop out on the top.

Use your fingers to further remove the keyboard from the chassis, while the laptop is in its normal orientation.

Step 10: Disconnect the cables and remove the motherboard

One FFC cable can be found at the keyboard place.

The other cables are on the other side. Make sure that you have disconnected all cables.

You can now gently remove the motherboard.

Step 11: Move the other parts to the new C cover top case palm rest part

Remove the two power button daughterboard screws and disconnect the FFC cable. Remove the power button daughterboard itself as well as the belonging cable and place it in the new C cover top case palm rest part.

Repeat this step for the other parts that are still on the old C cover top case palm rest part, such as the speakers, the CMOS battery, the WiFi antennas (if needed), the front LED daughterboard, the touchpad, the USB audio board and the main battery.

For reference, please consult the corresponding replacement instructions.

Step 12: C cover palm rest part replacement

Remove the hinge screws. Pull the hinges up with the spudger tool. Do this at both sides (both hinges).

Make sure that the screen cable is no longer touching the C cover palm rest part.

Rotate the old C cover palm rest part until it can be taken away from the screen assembly part.

Place the new C cover palm rest part the same way as you took the old one out.

Put the screen cable back in its correct place.

Push the hinges back down. Reinstall its screws.

Step 13: Reinstall the motherboard

Install the new motherboard while making sure that all the cables are visible.

You can use the spudger to easily grab the cables in case they are laying under the motherobard.

Now connect all cables to the motherboard. Remember that there is one more FFC cable on the other side.

Step 14: Apply thermal paste

Put some thermal paste on the spatula.

Spread it out on the CPU (and NVIDIA GPU, if present) evenly.

Make sure that you no longer see the mirroring effect of the CPU (and NVIDIA GPU, if present).

Step 15: Reinstall the heatsink

Carefully place the heatsink back in its original position.

Make sure that you don’t move the heatsink after putting it back in place.

Install and tighten the heatsink screws and reconnect the heatsink cables.

Step 16: Reinstall the internal memory module(s)

You can now reinstall the internal memory module(s).

To install your new internal memory module, insert it with an angle of about 30°.

Push the module down at the outside until you hear a click.

Step 17: Reinstall the SSD storage drive(s)

You can now reinstall the SSD storage drive(s).

To install your new SSD, insert it with an angle of about 10-30°, depending on how smooth the SSD goes in.

Make sure it is pushed correctly in its slot, but don’t use excessive force. Once it’s in, push the module down at the outside and install the belonging screw.

Important:
Please make sure that the thermal pads that are delivered with the laptop are placed at the indicated places. The thermal pads make sure that your SSD remains cool, even under heavy load.

It is vital to have them in place to ensure a long life time of your SSD storage drive.

Step 18: Reinstall the WiFi module

You can now reinstall the WiFi module.

To install your WiFi module, insert it with an angle of about 30°. Reattach the antenna cables, but please don’t use excessive force since the antennas and the antenna plugs are fragile.

Make sure that the module is pushed correctly in its slot. Once it’s in, push the module down at the outside and install the belonging screw.

Important:
The antenna cables and the plugs at the module are fragile. Make sure you push the antennas in place with proper force – never use excessive force.

The white WiFi antenna plug shuold be attached to MAIN, while the transparent WiFi antenna plug should be attached to AUX.

Step 19: Reinstall the keyboard

Make sure that there is soft material on the palm rest part. This will prevent scratches.

Put the keyboard upside down on this soft material to easily attach the keyboard cables to the motherboard.

Put the keyboard in its correct position.

Make sure that you put the bottom side in its place first by shifting it to the bottom.

Press the keyboard on all sides.

Step 20: Place the bottom case back in place

Install the bottom case by placing it back in the right position.

Gently press the part on all sides.

Make sure that the bottom case fits snugly on all sides.

Step 21: Install the screws

Use the screwdriver to install the screws back in place.

This was the final step, you are ready to use your laptop again.

Well done!
